## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive; confirmations: mixed sector returns (Materials/Real Estate/Healthcare/Utilities/Financials positive while Tech/Consumer/Energy/Industrials negative) and concentrated top-performer mix (3/5 Materials), producing no clear directional signal.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: NEM (1W: +12.09% | 1M: -3.99%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: -6.66%) RECOVERY, NUE (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -1.74%) RECOVERY. Real Estate: CCI (1W: +5.03% | 1M: -9.33%) RECOVERY. Healthcare: PFE (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +7.41%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +4.73% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Materials).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -8.56%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -4.21% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary lagging: NKE (1W: -15.76% | 1M: -24.85%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -2.85%) BELOW TREND. Energy soft: CVX (1W: -3.77% | 1M: +4.58%) CORRECTION, XOM (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +5.89%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NEM (1W: +12.09% | 1M: -3.99%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: -6.66%) RECOVERY, NUE (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -1.74%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +5.03% | 1M: -9.33%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +2.93%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentration: Concentrated (3/5 Materials); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NKE (1W: -15.76% | 1M: -24.85%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -13.86%) BELOW TREND, UL (1W: -7.80% | 1M: -18.93%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -5.47% | 1M: -0.50%) BELOW TREND, PM (1W: -4.94% | 1M: -10.79%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Consumer and select Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: NEM (1W: +12.09%), FCX (1W: +7.20%), NUE (1W: +5.54%), CCI (1W: +5.03%), PANW (1W: +4.86%) — note MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large-cap techs (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL) with conflicting 1W vs 1M signals; watch for trend breaks and likely short-term noise.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed, with patches of strength but overall pressure: PANW (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +2.93%) ABOVE TREND while MSFT (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -8.56%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND; several chip names show CORRECTION (AMAT (1W: -4.21% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION, AMD (1W: -4.57% | 1M: +10.09%) CORRECTION).

8. Financials Outlook?
Muted / mixed: Financials 1W: +0.33% with many names flat-to-negative; JPM (1W: -0.01% | 1M: -1.63%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -2.21% | 1M: -6.23%) BELOW TREND — no broad cyclical leadership visible.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Relatively constructive: PFE (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +7.41%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +4.73% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.27% | 1M: -4.53%) RECOVERY and LLY (1W: +4.17% | 1M: -5.28%) RECOVERY — sector showing idiosyncratic strength amid mixed macro.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Materials and Healthcare exposure (NEM RECOVERY, PFE ABOVE TREND, BMY ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to stretched consumer and large-cap tech where trends are broken (NKE BELOW TREND, MSFT BELOW TREND, NVDA BELOW TREND); style: mixed / no clear leadership. Monitor major divergence in big-tech and news-driven mismatches before adding risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PFE (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +7.41%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +4.73% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +12.09% | 1M: -3.99%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -15.76% | 1M: -24.85%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -4.21% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +2.68%; leadership concentrated), Healthcare (1W: +1.48%). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.74%), Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.37%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for failure to reclaim near-term 50-day pivot as a risk signal; AAPL (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -3.08%) RECOVERY — monitor hold of recent lows for confirmation; NEM (1W: +12.09% | 1M: -3.99%) RECOVERY — continuation above this week’s breakout keeps momentum intact.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+80): LLY (1W: +4.17% | 1M: -5.28%) RECOVERY — news on GLP-1 pill and AI partnership aligns with 1W strength (confirmation). CAT (+50): CAT (1W: +1.57% | 1M: +1.13%) ABOVE TREND — analyst upgrade confirming price action. LRCX (+55): LRCX (1W: -4.90% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION — strong DRAM price news but price falling = divergence, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MA (-50): MA (1W: -2.21% | 1M: -6.23%) BELOW TREND — FTC probe headlines confirm weakness. PM (-50): PM (1W: -4.94% | 1M: -10.79%) BELOW TREND — negative sentiment confirmed by price. (Note: watch for news-driven volatility where price and sentiment diverge.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. NEM (RECOVERY), PFE (ABOVE TREND) and PANW (ABOVE TREND) are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among mega-cap tech (AAPL RECOVERY vs MSFT BELOW TREND vs NVDA BELOW TREND) and several news vs price mismatches (e.g., LRCX bullish headlines but CORRECTION) — monitor for trend confirmation.
